about: Per-component floors enforced by scripts/ci/coverage_gate.py. Each floor is the coverage measured on 2026-10-13 in the mode CI runs, truncated to one decimal; every component is below the 95% policy, so the floor stops further drops while the gap is closed. Raise a floor when coverage rises; never lower one to make a pull request pass. See docs/development/CI_GATES.md.

sdk-typescript.mode: npm run test:unit -- --coverage (unit tests, no server)

sdk-python.mode: pytest (unit tests; the s2s suites skip without a server)

sdk-csharp.mode: dotnet test --collect "XPlat Code Coverage" (unit tests; the S2S tests skip without a server)
